hypotheses.description: Trend entries require a counter-trend pullback followed by close-based continuation.
hypotheses.direction_rule: BUY when EMA50 > EMA200; SELL when EMA50 < EMA200.
hypotheses.entry_rule: At candle close, prior three-bar return is counter-trend and close is back beyond EMA50.
hypotheses.exit_rule: Stop/target are canonical ATR multiples; close at stop, target, or timeout.
hypotheses.expected_failure_mode: Pullbacks persist or trend regime changes before continuation.
hypotheses.invalidation_criteria: Reject if conservative expectancy is non-positive in at least three development windows.
hypotheses.market_behavior_assumption: Established EMA direction resumes after a temporary counter-trend move.
hypotheses.stop_rule: Canonical engine stop at 1.5 ATR from next-open entry.
hypotheses.target_rule: Canonical engine target at 3.0 ATR from next-open entry.

hypotheses.description: Compression resolves through a close beyond the prior twenty-bar range.
hypotheses.direction_rule: BUY above prior high; SELL below prior low, with EMA context only as a direction tie-breaker.
hypotheses.entry_rule: At candle close, current close breaks the prior twenty-bar high/low after range compression.
hypotheses.exit_rule: Stop/target are canonical ATR multiples; close at stop, target, or timeout.
hypotheses.expected_failure_mode: Breakout is false or expansion is already exhausted at entry.
hypotheses.invalidation_criteria: Reject if positive gross expectancy does not survive conservative friction.
hypotheses.market_behavior_assumption: Low recent range relative to ATR precedes directional expansion.
hypotheses.stop_rule: Canonical engine stop at 1.5 ATR from next-open entry.
hypotheses.target_rule: Canonical engine target at 3.0 ATR from next-open entry.

hypotheses.description: Extreme ATR-normalized displacement reverts when EMA trend separation is small.
hypotheses.direction_rule: BUY oversold downside displacement; SELL overbought upside displacement.
hypotheses.entry_rule: At candle close, RSI is extreme and price displacement from EMA50 exceeds one ATR while EMA separation is modest.
hypotheses.exit_rule: Stop/target are canonical ATR multiples; close at stop, target, or timeout.
hypotheses.expected_failure_mode: Trend persistence overwhelms reversion or extremes are too rare.
hypotheses.invalidation_criteria: Reject if fewer than ten total development trades or if any window breaches risk validation.
hypotheses.market_behavior_assumption: Non-trending markets mean-revert after sufficiently stretched closes.
hypotheses.stop_rule: Canonical engine stop at 1.5 ATR from next-open entry.
hypotheses.target_rule: Canonical engine target at 3.0 ATR from next-open entry.
